name: PocketBase
description: Self-hosted PocketBase with auth, a realtime SQLite database, file storage, and an admin dashboard in one small service.

build.dockerfile:
FROM alpine:3.22
ARG PB_VERSION=0.40.1
RUN apk add --no-cache ca-certificates su-exec unzip wget \
    && wget -q https://github.com/pocketbase/pocketbase/releases/download/v${PB_VERSION}/pocketbase_${PB_VERSION}_linux_amd64.zip -O /tmp/pocketbase.zip \
    && unzip /tmp/pocketbase.zip -d /pb \
    && rm /tmp/pocketbase.zip \
    && addgroup -S pocketbase \
    && adduser -S -G pocketbase -h /pb pocketbase \
    && chown -R pocketbase:pocketbase /pb
COPY pocketbase/entrypoint.sh /pb/entrypoint.sh
RUN chmod 755 /pb/entrypoint.sh
WORKDIR /pb
EXPOSE 8090
ENTRYPOINT ["/pb/entrypoint.sh"]
CMD ["/pb/pocketbase", "serve", "--http=0.0.0.0:8090", "--encryptionEnv=PB_ENCRYPTION_KEY"]

files.content:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
mkdir -p /pb/pb_data
chown -R pocketbase:pocketbase /pb/pb_data
export PB_ENCRYPTION_KEY="$(printf '%.32s' "$PB_ENCRYPTION_SEED")"
exec su-exec pocketbase "$@"

prepare.title: Create the superuser
prepare.description: Creates or updates the PocketBase dashboard account.
prepare.command: set -e; export PB_ENCRYPTION_KEY="$(printf '%.32s' "$PB_ENCRYPTION_SEED")"; /pb/pocketbase superuser upsert "$POCKETBASE_SUPERUSER_EMAIL" "$POCKETBASE_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD" --dir=/pb/pb_data --encryptionEnv=PB_ENCRYPTION_KEY >/dev/null; echo ready
